newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe stocks continue upward march on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe stocks continue upward march on Wednesday.

text.p: Zimbabwean shares continued their upward march on Wednesday with brokers saying they saw no immediate slowdown in the bull-run being fuelled by prospects of lower interest rates and some good company results.
The key 57-share industrial index soared 87.74 points -- or 1.3 percent -- to break through the 6,600 psychological barrier, closing at a record 6,674.19.

Leading Wednesday's winners, cement producer Porthold leapt 60 cents to 1,200, blue-chip conglomerate Delta rose 50 cents to 3,150, Truworths climbed 25 cents to 750 while finance group Finhold at 750, steel firm FSI at 220, engineering group Gulliver at 140, sugar producer Hippo at 800 and tobacco company TSL at 410 all gained 20 cents.
Minings were quiet with Mhangura slipping two cents to 20. The seven-counter mining index edged a marginal 0.03 points to end at 1,403.08.
